_note: In-app event copy for Spooky Season 2026. name and shortDescription are the app's own approved season strings (firebase/scripts/seasons.json). longDescription is new and needs native review in every locale except en-US. Limits: name 30, short 50, long 120 characters.

en-US.name: Spooky Season
en-US.longDescription: Flip through 30 haunted levels full of ghosts, bats and jack-o'-lanterns with Flippo. Spooky Season ends November 2!

es-MX.name: Temporada de Sustos
es-MX.longDescription: Voltea 30 niveles embrujados con fantasmas, murciélagos y calabazas junto a Flippo. ¡Termina el 2 de noviembre!

de-DE.name: Gruselsaison
de-DE.longDescription: Deck mit Flippo 30 gruselige Level voller Geister, Fledermäuse und Kürbisse auf. Die Gruselsaison endet am 2. November!

fr-FR.name: Saison Frisson
fr-FR.longDescription: Retourne 30 niveaux hantés pleins de fantômes, de chauves-souris et de citrouilles avec Flippo. Fin le 2 novembre !

hi.name: डरावना सीज़न
hi.longDescription: Flippo के साथ भूतों, चमगादड़ों और कद्दुओं से भरे 30 भुतहा लेवल खेलें। यह सीज़न 2 नवंबर को खत्म होगा!

it.name: Stagione da Brivido
it.longDescription: Gira 30 livelli infestati pieni di fantasmi, pipistrelli e zucche insieme a Flippo. La stagione finisce il 2 novembre!

ja.name: ハロウィンシーズン
ja.longDescription: Flippoと一緒に、おばけやコウモリ、ジャック・オー・ランタンがいっぱいの30のおばけレベルに挑戦しよう。11月2日まで!

ko.name: 스푸키 시즌
ko.longDescription: Flippo와 함께 유령, 박쥐, 호박 등불이 가득한 유령 레벨 30개를 뒤집어 보세요. 11월 2일까지!

pt-BR.name: Temporada do Susto
pt-BR.longDescription: Vire 30 níveis assombrados cheios de fantasmas, morcegos e abóboras com o Flippo. A temporada acaba em 2 de novembro!

zh-Hans.name: 万圣节赛季
zh-Hans.longDescription: 和 Flippo 一起翻开 30 个满是幽灵、蝙蝠和南瓜灯的闹鬼关卡。万圣节赛季 11 月 2 日结束!
